title: Packaged build orchestration and process identity controls
summary: Concurrent builds and event-driven runtime status are backed by persistent registries and process-identity revalidation.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Implemented concurrent packaged-module builds, persistent process registries, event-driven UI updates and production process controls in the engineering workbench.
Revalidated process IDs, start times and recorded executables before process-control actions; renderer readiness checks actual bundle assets rather than assuming a watcher means a completed build.
Added mocked IPC regressions and an opt-in live packaged test lane; the supplied analysis does not establish execution of that lane.
